text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the day of the Nikkei Sho arrived for Sounds of Earth, meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Far across the sea, in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ...Today is finally the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...I have to give it my all.
Every last bit of my strength...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: A-A call? Who could it be—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—From the East with love.
Your friend, Sounds of Earth."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Earth...!
What's wrong, all of a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I wanted to tell you this, as you prepare to fight in a distant land.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember?
Today, right after this, I will be running in the Nikkei Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Proud to be part of the same generation as you,
I will give it my all. So—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—Please, run proudly across Dubai's soil
as a representative
of our generation."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Just that fact alone is surely enough...
It gives us courage. It makes us stronger."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Earth...——

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
“......Thanks.
I've got my head back in the game.”

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all and run with no regrets.
So you do your best in the Nikkei Sho too, Earth."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
Well, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please enjoy yourself as well!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (—Fufu, what a heavy atmosphere.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Only veteran musicians could pull this off.
My heart is racing...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ââHey there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Shion-san!
The day has finally come!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......That's pretty impressive.
You don't look nervous at all, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Because I simply cannot wait to hear what kind of melody you will bring forth!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...All I'm aiming for is victory.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here... including you...
I have no intention of losing to any of you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Now that's what I'm talking about!
